image_slots.scene_description: 'কাক' — একটি কাক (crow; key-word subject; ব্যবহারকারীর নির্দেশে জীব-ফিগার রক্ষিত)। living_being=true → স্ট্রাইপ ট্রিটমেন্ট প্রযোজ্য।
image_slots.compliance_note: KEPT as living being per user instruction (কাক IS the key word — a crow; sentence 'কাক ডাকে।'). single bird, no human, no dress/cast. contains_living_being=true -> programmatic stripe applied OUTSIDE chat at image-ref step; keep the whole crow body (head, beak, legs) clear of the stripe band so it stays recognizable. bw: native_safe.
image_slots.prompt: A friendly children's-textbook illustration of a single black crow standing in profile on plain ground, its beak and legs clearly shown, perhaps with its beak slightly open as if calling. Just the one bird. No people, no other animals, no text. Plain white/pale background. Soft watercolour style, clean clear linework. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy legibility.

image_slots.scene_description: 'ঘি' — objects-only: একটি ঘি-এর কৌটা/বয়াম (NCTB-অনুরূপ; কোনো জীব নেই)।
image_slots.compliance_note: object-only — a jar of ghee, no living being. No stripe.
image_slots.prompt: A children's-textbook illustration of a single small labelled jar of ghee (clarified butter) with a lid, resting on a plain surface. No people, no animals, no living beings. Plain light background. Soft watercolour style, clean clear linework. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy legibility.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ৩৬ এসো পড়ি ও লিখি (skeleton row 249, 2 periods). FIRST SHORT-SENTENCE lesson (ছোট বাক্য) — outcome ১৩.৩.১ (বাক্য গঠন), first decodable full sentences in the book. CODES: যোগ্যতা ১.২/৫.১/৯.১/১৩.৩, শিখনফল ১.২.২/৫.২.২/৯.২.৪/১৩.৩.১ (per TG row 36). action=retain-curated, severity=S2 (kept living-being কাক with stripe). C-05 (image living-being doctrine), C-06 (key words). CONTENT: 3 word->sentence pairs (কাক ডাকে / ঘি কিনি / নীল আকাশ); পড়ি-ও-লিখি trace boxes (কাক/ঘি/নীল); লিখি model sentence 'আমি নদী দেখি।' + blank ruled lines. USER DECISION: KEEP the crow কাক as living being with stripe (img-01) per user instruction ('keep crow with stripe'), consistent with বক/ময়না/পায়রা/ফড়িং/হাঁস@পাঠ33-35. Only object image = ঘি jar (img-02). Trace/write assets = vector (img-03). LETTER-AUDIT: ALL sentences + words inventory-clean @36 (first sentence lesson — every decodable sentence audited, all pass: কাক ডাকে/ঘি কিনি/নীল আকাশ/আমি নদী দেখি). Nothing omitted. FLAGGED FOR REVIEWER: (a) stripe placement on কাক must keep the whole crow body clear of the band; (b) keep the লিখি blank ruled lines empty in the print edition (child's own-sentence practice — do not pre-fill). bw_treatment=native_safe.
